# Six researched investments — build-ready planning package

All six streams are researched and translated into a coordinated design and actual contracts. Start with [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) for safe integration with the running Claude orchestrator, then [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md). The canonical amendment is §55; 38 new requirements are routed to exactly one owner in [REQUIREMENTS.csv](REQUIREMENTS.csv). [PLAN.json](PLAN.json) defines 40 ordered rows: 28 feature contracts, three prerequisite/publication markers, and the full nine-row tail including acceptance.

This package implements planning and validation tooling only. It does not claim completed repairs, human adjudication, acquisition or publication. The existing active checkout/control ledger was left untouched.

| Stream | Main conclusion | Concrete output and owners |
|---|---|---|
| [S1 — evidence integrity](research/S1-evidence-integrity.md) | The principal risk is loss or misinterpretation at pipeline seams, despite strong underlying evidence/append-only architecture. Actual-capture binding, qualifiers, source roles, occurrence time and public eligibility need one tested contract. | P32.2–6, P32.22, P32.23a, P32.25; bounded historical audit and honest unrecoverable states |
| [S2 — local dossiers](research/S2-local-dossiers.md) | Use Oklahoma City, Tulsa and San Diego to prove useful answers and adversarial semantics. Unknowns are allowed; unsupported affirmative claims and inflated completion are not. | P32.17–20; twelve-question rubric, exact fact-to-capture ledger, independent semantic review |
| [S3 — human evaluation](research/S3-human-evaluation.md) | Model agreement cannot establish human ground truth. Candidate-specific sampling and a sealed independent assessment must precede new auto-write certification. | P32.9–10; H4 development → P32.22a candidate/frame freeze → H5 final labels → P32.23 measured decision |
| [S4 — public product](research/S4-public-product.md) | Improve the existing static core and three islands. Full-corpus released search, specific records, real immutable citations and durable applied corrections have higher immediate value than a second SPA. | P32.13–16a, P32.24; existing API + immutable per-compartment FTS5, bounded navigation, separate intake/application authority |
| [S5 — source strategy](research/S5-source-strategy.md) | Acquire evidence that closes named relationship/governance gaps. Deduplicate existing registry/P31 work and mirrors before counting value. | P32.11–12/.21; [27 researched candidates](data/source-candidates.csv), per-row review depth, rights/lineage/cost passports, bounded pilot |
| [S6 — build memory](research/S6-build-memory.md) | Preserve history while making current state compact, explicit and mechanically consistent. A generated view is not another control ledger. | P32.1/.7/.8 and docs tail; shadow migration, evidence-backed status transitions, authoritative closeout transaction and freshness checks |

The most important corrections to the initial audit are preserved in the research: the OCFL architecture exists but the production assertion seam loses important bindings/metadata; the fraction of unrecoverable history has not been measured; the OSM publisher/operator error is demonstrated in code, while its exact public incidence requires audit; Oklahoma City's numbers describe different scopes and an approximate derived sum; a Tulsa template is not an executed contract; and San Diego's subscription-only program does not establish local hardware. The candidate inventory is researched at differing depths, not uniformly fully inspected or rights-cleared.

Four independent review artifacts and follow-ups led to concrete design fixes. [REVIEW_CLOSURE.md](REVIEW_CLOSURE.md) records them, including release hash self-reference, current withdrawals during rollback, per-source temporal candidate sets, stale-worktree closeout, missing correction application, and candidate-before-sample evaluation ordering. [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) separates planning/test evidence from future live acceptance.

Existing P31 work keeps its owners. Import this planning branch at a clean ticket boundary; finish P31.19, reconcile the actual landed baseline at P32.1, then run the new sequence. Pending human/source/operational/publication obligations are explicitly registered; no new gate is signed by this package.

For the operator’s next ticket-boundary pause, [INTEGRATION_RUNBOOK.md](INTEGRATION_RUNBOOK.md) defines the complete Codex-owned branch/import/stacked-PR/checkout handoff, including all six valid pause boundaries, P31.19 activation, collision handling, validation and recovery. The read-only preflight and its disposable-repository tests live under `tools/`.

Integration after P31.19 is recorded in [integration/2026-09-26-after-p31-19.md](integration/2026-09-26-after-p31-19.md). Current branch/next-ticket authority is the actual LEDGER, not the research snapshot; no implementation row is marked complete by the import.
